description:
In multiple places, URI.parse is called without proper nil checking:

1. fetcher.cr line ~300:  parses redirect location but some code paths assume it succeeds
2. The  method returns  when current_uri might be nil
3. handle_result_action expects URI? but not all callers ensure it's set

While Crystal's type system catches many issues at compile time, the Result/redirect handling has edge cases where nil URI could cause runtime errors.

Example: If URI.parse fails in handle_redirect_action for a redirect URL, the code continues but with a nil URI, which may cause issues in subsequent iterations.
title: Add missing null checks for URI parsing failures in redirect handling
